question: Radhika moves 30 metres in West direction. Then she turns to her right and moves 10 metres and then she turns to her left and moves 30 metres. In which direction is she now from the starting point?
solution:
Given,

Radhika moves 30 metres in West direction.

Then she turns to her right and moves 10 metres.

According to the statements, the direction and distance diagram is shown below;
